timeline.event: The company says Mike Huberty founded Madison Ghost Walks in 2010; the exact founding day is not specified.
Wisconsin records show Huberty, LLC organized with the former name American Hauntings, LLC.
The company's dated Shark Tank announcement described 25 locations across seven states and Puerto Rico and identified Mike Huberty as owner.
Wisconsin records show Huberty, LLC restored to good standing after a January 2026 delinquency event; the record also shows a prior 2024 delinquency/restoration cycle.
The current site offers bookable tours across 10+ destinations and identifies the business in site copy as Huberty LLC DBA American Ghost Walks.

registry_records.limitation: The state record establishes entity status and name history, but it does not by itself prove that every tour marketed under the American Ghost Walks brand is contracted by this entity.

claims.text: American Ghost Walks is operating as a current tour business, not merely a historical Shark Tank brand.
The Wisconsin legal entity behind the current site is Huberty, LLC, formerly American Hauntings, LLC, and the state currently lists it as restored to good standing.
The company's footprint claims changed between its 2023 Shark Tank announcement and its current site; the tracker preserves both dates rather than treating the numbers as timeless facts.
Whether a Shark Tank deal was finalized after filming is unresolved in this record.

The televised Daymond John deal is unresolved: Shark Tank Blog reported no evidence it closed, while Food Republic later reported that it did.
A live storefront must not be treated as proof that the Shark Tank investment closed.

timeline.event: The federal BAM trademark application identifies Trusted Foods LLC, a Delaware LLC, as applicant for plant-based milk and related goods.

A dated official BAM article says retail sales temporarily paused while the company addressed manufacturing and formulation problems and prepared a relaunch; the exact publication date is not exposed in the fetched page.
The official press release says BAM debuted in select Southern California Whole Foods stores and names Trusted Foods LLC as maker.
BAM appeared in the Season 16, Episode 14 Shark Tank corpus as a no-deal pitch.
The current official site continues to present BAM and its buckwheat-milk mission, while a current official article footer identifies BAM the Brand Inc.

events: Federal trademark application identifies the applicant as a Delaware LLC
registry_records.limitation: The Delaware entity-search portal was not completed in this pass, and the BAM the Brand Inc name in the current official article footer has not yet been reconciled to Trusted Foods LLC through a state filing.
